nodes.label: CI Job (lint / typecheck / test / build)
nodes.rationale: The build step runs with a dummy AUTH_SECRET and DATABASE_URL=':memory:' because force-dynamic pages run no queries at build time, but the libSQL client still opens its connection eagerly at import and the gitignored data/ dir doesn't exist in CI.

nodes.label: Non-Blocking e2e CI Job
nodes.rationale: Runs in parallel with no `needs` and continue-on-error because e2e is a signal, not a gate, while the suite is young; promote to blocking later by removing continue-on-error. Uploads the Playwright report only on failure.
